mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendances WHERE attendance_date = #{centerToday}) AS today_check_in_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendances WHERE attendance_date = #{centerToday} - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS yesterday_check_in_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_memberships WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN start_date AND end_date) AS active_membership_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE joined_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01')) AS new_member_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM payments p WHERE p.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED','REFUNDED') AND p.paid_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01')) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.refunded_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01')) AS monthly_sales, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_memberships WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS expiring_membership_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendances WHERE checked_out_at IS NULL) AS current_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendances WHERE attendance_date = #{centerToday} AND checked_out_at IS NOT NULL) AS checked_out_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendances WHERE attendance_date = #{centerToday} AND checked_out_at IS NULL) AS open_attendance_alert_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members m WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.trainer_requested = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trainer_assignments ta WHERE ta.member_id = m.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE')) AS trainer_request_alert_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment WHERE status IN ('INSPECTION','REPAIR','UNAVAILABLE')) AS facility_alert_count, ((SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attendances WHERE attendance_date = #{centerToday} AND checked_out_at IS NULL)) + (SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM members m WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.trainer_requested = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trainer_assignments ta WHERE ta.member_id = m.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE'))) + (SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM equipment WHERE status IN ('INSPECTION','REPAIR','UNAVAILABLE')))) AS alert_count

SELECT (FLOOR((HOUR(checked_in_at) - 6) / 3) * 3 + 6) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM attendances WHERE attendance_date = #{centerToday} AND HOUR(checked_in_at) BETWEEN 6 AND 23 GROUP BY (FLOOR((HOUR(checked_in_at) - 6) / 3) * 3 + 6) ORDER BY hour

SELECT type, title, description, occurred_at FROM ( SELECT 'ATTENDANCE' AS type, CONCAT(m.name, ' 회원 체크인') AS title, 'QR 출석' AS description, a.checked_in_at AS occurred_at FROM attendances a JOIN members m ON m.id = a.member_id UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYMENT', CONCAT(m.name, ' 회원 결제 완료'), COALESCE(mp.name, '회원권 결제'), p.paid_at FROM payments p JOIN members m ON m.id = p.member_id LEFT JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.id = p.member_membership_id LEFT JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE p.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED') UNION ALL SELECT 'MEMBER', CONCAT(m.name, ' 신규 회원 가입'), CASE WHEN m.trainer_requested THEN '트레이너 상담 희망' ELSE '트레이너 희망 안 함' END, m.created_at FROM members m UNION ALL SELECT 'FACILITY', CONCAT(e.name, ' 점검 기록'), ml.description, ml.performed_at FROM equipment_maintenance_logs ml JOIN equipment e ON e.id = ml.equipment_id ) activity ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT mm.id AS membership_id, mm.member_id, m.name AS member_name, mp.name AS product_name, mm.end_date, DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS remaining_days FROM member_memberships mm JOIN members m ON m.id = mm.member_id JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 7 DAY ORDER BY mm.end_date, mm.id LIMIT 5
